# Rules

Ubon has 11 rules in 2 packs. A `block` finding stops an agent from finishing and fails `ubon check`; a `warn` finding is reported and does not. `ubon rules` prints this list with the levels set in your `ubon.json`.

## secret

Credentials in code, config, prompts, and tool output.

| Rule | Level | What it catches |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [secret/provider-key](secret/provider-key.md) | block | Provider credential in source |
| [secret/db-url-password](secret/db-url-password.md) | block | Database URL with a password |
| [secret/public-env-name](secret/public-env-name.md) | block | Secret in a browser-exposed env variable |
| [secret/env-file-committed](secret/env-file-committed.md) | block | .env file with secrets that git can commit |
| [secret/key-file-committed](secret/key-file-committed.md) | block | Private key or credential file in git |
| [secret/server-env-in-client](secret/server-env-in-client.md) | warn | Server env variable read in browser code |
| [secret/in-prompt](secret/in-prompt.md) | block | Provider key in a prompt |
| [secret/in-tool-output](secret/in-tool-output.md) | warn | Provider key in tool output |
| [secret/read-sensitive-file](secret/read-sensitive-file.md) | block | Agent reads a secrets file |

## integrity

Changes that weaken the checks: skipped or deleted tests, disabled type checks, lowered thresholds, and suppressions.

| Rule | Level | What it catches |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [integrity/invalid-suppression](integrity/invalid-suppression.md) | warn | Suppression without a valid reason |
| [integrity/unused-suppression](integrity/unused-suppression.md) | warn | Suppression that no longer matches a finding |
